name: AI Deep Dive — CEG — 2026-05-02
rationale: Constellation Energy (CEG) is perfectly positioned as the largest operator of nuclear power plants in the US, providing the reliable, carbon-free baseload power desperately needed by AI data centers. With strong FCF generation ($1.28B) and solid margins, it trades at a forward P/E of 22.5x, reflecting its premium utility status. My weighted fair value of $341 indicates modest upside, making it a solid BUY for stable, long-term AI infrastructure exposure.

aiThesis.rationale: Constellation Energy is the premier utility play on the AI data center boom. Unlike speculative infrastructure providers, CEG owns the actual baseload nuclear generation required to power gigawatt-scale AI clusters reliably and cleanly. Hyperscalers are increasingly willing to pay a premium (e.g., via long-term PPAs) for carbon-free, 24/7 power, creating a massive structural moat. Generating strong free cash flow and maintaining a Piotroski F-Score of 5, the company is financially solid. While trading at a premium 22.5x forward P/E for a utility, the 'AI power premium' is justified. The base case models steady 12% growth and margin expansion via lucrative hyperscaler contracts, yielding a $357 present value.
